```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggh4x)
file_sources <- list.files(here("scripts"), pattern = "*.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(file_sources, source))

th <- theme_surface_default(base_size = 18, square = TRUE) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.5, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")
  )
out_dir <- here("figs", "poster_simple")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

axis_lab_T <- expression("Temperature, " * T * " (" * degree * C * ")")
axis_lab_O2 <- expression("Ambient oxygen, " * p[O[2]*","*env] * " (kPa)")

tr <- list(a_A=80,b_R=0.78,a_O=5,b_d=0.75,b_v=0.15,K_g=2.0,h_g=2.0,a_E=20,b_E=2/3,a_C=60,b_C=0.75,alpha_M=0.1,b_M=0.75,alpha_SDA=0.2,alpha_exc=0.1,T_ref=10,E_M=0.50,E_C=0.50,E_A=0.10,E_O=0.25)
pO2seq <- seq(0,30,by=0.2)
Tseq <- seq(0,30,by=0.2)
prey_seq <- seq(0,1,by=0.004)
masses <- c(1e1, 1e5)

alloc_cols <- c("Basal metabolism"="#440154","Active metabolism"="#8a5796","SDA"="#e0bce8","Excretion"="gray90","Available energy"="#67A5CA")
```

```{r metabolic-allocation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# single-stressor and compound-stressor metabolic allocation panels
mass_seq <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 120)

make_alloc <- function(scen_tbl, fname){
  alloc_state <- purrr::pmap_dfr(scen_tbl, function(scenario, T, pO2, f_ref) {
    B_vec <- B_from_f(f_ref=rep(f_ref,length(mass_seq)), w=mass_seq, tr=tr, T_ref=rep(10,length(mass_seq)), pO2_ref=rep(25,length(mass_seq)), U_lo=1e-5, U_mech=5, enforce_O2_feasible=TRUE)
    purrr::map2_dfr(mass_seq, B_vec, function(m, B) {
      st <- find_U_opt(pO2_env=pO2, T=T, w=m, prey=B, tr=tr, U_lo=1e-5, U_mech=5)
      tibble(scenario=scenario,mass=m,Cmax=st$Cmax,f=st$f,g=st$g,
             `Basal metabolism`=st$M_m,`Active metabolism`=st$M_act,SDA=st$D_SDA,Excretion=st$M_exc,`Available energy`=st$E_net)
    })
  })
  process_levels <- c("Basal metabolism", "Active metabolism", "SDA", "Excretion", "Available energy")
  al <- alloc_state %>%
    pivot_longer(cols=all_of(process_levels), names_to="Process", values_to="value") %>%
    mutate(value_norm=value/Cmax, Process=factor(Process, levels=process_levels)) %>%
    arrange(scenario, mass, Process)
  fg <- alloc_state %>%
    select(scenario,mass,f,g) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols=c(g,f), names_to="Limiter", values_to="value") %>%
    mutate(Limiter=factor(Limiter, levels=c("f","g")))
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_area(data=al, aes(mass,value_norm, fill=Process, group=Process), position="stack", color="gray50", linewidth=0.25) +
    geom_line(data=fg, aes(mass,value,colour=Limiter,linetype=Limiter,group=Limiter), linewidth=0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=alloc_cols) +
    scale_colour_manual(values=c(f="#238b45", g="#6a51a3")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values=c(f="dashed", g="dashed")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,1),expand=c(0,0)) +
    facet_wrap(~scenario, nrow=1) +
    scale_x_log10(
      breaks = 10^c(-2, 0, 2, 4),
      labels = label_10pow(),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(x="Body mass, w (g)", y=expression("Allocation / " * C[max]), fill=NULL, colour=NULL, linetype=NULL) + th
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, fname), p, width=16, height=8, dpi=300)
  p
}

single_s <- tibble(scenario=c("Baseline","Oligotrophic","Hyperthermic","Hypoxic"), T=c(10,10,25,10), pO2=c(25,25,25,10), f_ref=c(0.75,0.5,0.75,0.75))
compound_s <- tibble(scenario=c("Oligotrophic+Hyperthermic","Oligotrophic+Hypoxic","Hyperthermic+Hypoxic","Hyperthermic+Hypoxic+Oligotrophic"), T=c(25,10,25,25), pO2=c(25,10,10,10), f_ref=c(0.5,0.5,0.75,0.5))

make_alloc(single_s, "met_alloc_single_stressor_4panel.png")
make_alloc(compound_s, "met_alloc_compound_stressor_4panel.png")
```

```{r owf-occurrence, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
out_obis <- here("data_out", "OBISwoaFishBase", "binOccurrencesCell__dT_0.50C__dO2_0.50kPa__T_0_30__pO2_0_30.csv")
woa_temp <- readr::read_csv(paste0(here(), "/../environment/data/woa18_95A4_t00an01.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
woa_po2 <- readr::read_csv(paste0(here(), "/../environment/data_out/woa18_all_pO2_kPa_an01.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
obs <- readr::read_csv(out_obis, show_col_types = FALSE)

to_bin_center <- function(x, binwidth, xrng){x2 <- pmin(pmax(x, xrng[1]), xrng[2]-1e-10); floor((x2-xrng[1])/binwidth)*binwidth + xrng[1] + binwidth/2}
woa_wide_to_long <- function(df, value_name){depth_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE")); df %>% pivot_longer(all_of(depth_cols), names_to="depth_col", values_to=value_name) %>% mutate(depth_m = readr::parse_number(depth_col)) %>% select(-depth_col)}

occ <- obs %>% filter(group=="epipelagic", mass_bin %in% c("10^1 g","10^5 g")) %>% mutate(mass_lab=factor(mass_bin, levels=c("10^1 g","10^5 g"), labels=c("w == 10^1~g","w == 10^5~g")), T_bin=to_bin_center(T_bin,1,c(0,30)), O2_bin=to_bin_center(O2_bin,1,c(0,30))) %>% group_by(mass_lab,T_bin,O2_bin) %>% summarise(n=sum(n), .groups="drop")
woa <- inner_join(woa_wide_to_long(woa_temp,"temp_C"), woa_wide_to_long(woa_po2,"pO2_kPa"), by=c("LATITUDE","LONGITUDE","depth_m")) %>% filter(between(temp_C,0,30), between(pO2_kPa,0,30)) %>% mutate(T_bin=to_bin_center(temp_C,1,c(0,30)), O2_bin=to_bin_center(pO2_kPa,1,c(0,30))) %>% count(T_bin,O2_bin,name="woa_n") %>% mutate(rare_woa=(woa_n/sum(woa_n))<1e-5)

grid_df <- tidyr::crossing(mass_lab=factor(c("w == 10^1~g","w == 10^5~g"), levels=c("w == 10^1~g","w == 10^5~g")), T_bin=seq(0.5,29.5,1), O2_bin=seq(0.5,29.5,1)) %>% left_join(woa, by=c("T_bin","O2_bin")) %>% left_join(occ, by=c("mass_lab","T_bin","O2_bin")) %>% mutate(rare_woa=if_else(is.na(rare_woa), TRUE, rare_woa))

p_occ <- ggplot() + geom_tile(data=grid_df %>% filter(rare_woa), aes(T_bin,O2_bin), fill="grey82") + geom_tile(data=grid_df %>% filter(!is.na(n), n>0), aes(T_bin,O2_bin,fill=n)) + facet_grid(.~mass_lab, labeller=label_parsed) + scale_fill_gradient(low="#182B49", high="#251A2D", trans="log10") + scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,10,20,30), limits=c(0,30), expand=c(0,0)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0,10,20,30), limits=c(0,30), expand=c(0,0)) + labs(x=axis_lab_T,y=axis_lab_O2, fill="Cells") + th + theme(legend.position="bottom")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"owf_occurrence_two_sizes.png"), p_occ, width=8, height=4, dpi=300)
p_occ
```

```{r available-energy-and-diagnostics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# follow ABBmodel_test pattern: compute, optional interpolation, plot_surface_masked

d_comp <- compute_state_surface(tr, masses = c(1e1, 1e5), Tseq = seq(0,30,by=0.1), pO2seq = seq(0,30,by=0.1),
                                   preys = 0.75, prey_units = "prey_index", pair_mode = "cross", progress = TRUE %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass, levels = c(1e1, 1e5),
                    labels = c("w == 10^1~g", "w == 10^5~g"))
  )

p_en <- plot_surface_masked(d_comp, x = "T", y = "pO2", z = "E_net_norm", palette = "blue",
                    fill_title = "Available energy", x_limits = c(0,30), y_limits = c(0,30),
                    contours = list(
                      contour_spec(z = "f", breaks = seq(0.2,1,0.2), colour = "#238b45", linewidth = 0.55, linetype = "dashed"),
                      contour_spec(z = "g", breaks = seq(0.2,1,0.2), colour = "#6a51a3", linewidth = 0.55, linetype = "dashed")
                    ),
                    contour_data = d_comp,
                    theme = th) +
  facet_grid2(. ~ mass_lab, labeller = labeller(mass_lab = label_parsed)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0,10,20,30), limits = c(0,30), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0,10,20,30), limits = c(0,30), expand = c(0,0)) +
  labs(x = "Temperature, T (°C)", y = expression("Ambient oxygen, " * p[O[2]*","*env] * " (kPa)"))
ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"available_energy_T_pO2_two_sizes.png"), p_en, width=8, height=4, dpi=300)
p_en

# pO2 vs prey diagnostics at large fish (ABBmodel_test style + requested exclusion toggles)
d_test <- compute_state_surface(
  tr, masses=1e5, Tseq=10, pO2seq=pO2seq,
  preys=prey_seq, prey_units="prey_index",
  pair_mode="cross", progress=TRUE
) %>% add_masks()

d_test_eonly <- d_test %>% mutate(excl_o2 = FALSE)            # energetic-only overlay
d_test_o2only <- d_test %>% mutate(excl_e = FALSE)            # oxygen-only overlay
d_test_none  <- d_test %>% mutate(excl_o2 = FALSE, excl_e=FALSE) # no overlay

p1 <- plot_surface_masked(
  d_test_eonly, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="E_net_norm",
  palette="blue", fill_title="Available energy",
  x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
  mask_df=d_test_eonly, smooth_mask=TRUE, mask_nx=320, mask_ny=320,
  contours=contour_spec(z="E_net_norm", bins=5, linewidth=0.55, linetype="dashed"),
  theme=th
) + labs(x="Prey index", y=axis_lab_O2) + theme(legend.position="none")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"diag_available_energy.png"), p1, width=4, height=4, dpi=300)

p2 <- plot_surface_masked(
  d_test_o2only, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="pO2_int",
  palette="purple", fill_title="Interior oxygen",
  x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
  mask_df=d_test_o2only, smooth_mask=TRUE, mask_nx=320, mask_ny=320,
  contours=contour_spec(z="pO2_int", breaks=seq(0,30,5), linewidth=0.55, linetype="dashed"),
  theme=th
) + labs(x="Prey index", y=axis_lab_O2) + theme(legend.position="none")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"diag_oxygen_tension.png"), p2, width=4, height=4, dpi=300)

p3 <- plot_surface_masked(
  d_test_none, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="U_opt",
  palette="viridis", fill_title="U (m/s)",
  x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
  mask_df=d_test_none,
  contours=contour_spec(z="U_opt", bins=5, linewidth=0.55, linetype="dashed"),
  theme=th
) + labs(x="Prey index", y=axis_lab_O2) + theme(legend.position="none")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"diag_cruising_speed.png"), p3, width=4, height=4, dpi=300)

p4 <- plot_fg_bivariate(d_test, x="f_ref", y="pO2", x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30), contour_fg_mult=TRUE, theme=th) +
  labs(x="Prey index", y=axis_lab_O2) + theme(legend.position="none")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"diag_fg_bivariate.png"), p4, width=4, height=4, dpi=300)

key_df <- expand.grid(f=seq(0,1,length.out=200), g=seq(0,1,length.out=200))
key_p <- ggplot(key_df, aes(f,g, fill=f*g)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low="white", high="#182B49") +
  th + labs(x="f", y="g")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir,"diag_fg_bivariate_key.png"), key_p, width=4, height=4, dpi=300)
```

```{r temp-and-o2-limitation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Cross-sections sampled directly from state surfaces
mass_labs <- c("w == 10^1~g", "w == 10^5~g")

# Temperature cross-sections at fixed pO2 = 25 kPa
lines_T <- compute_state_surface(
  tr,
  masses = masses,
  Tseq = seq(0, 30, by = 0.1),
  pO2seq = 25,
  preys = c(0.5, 0.75),
  prey_units = "feeding_level",
  pair_mode = "cross",
  progress = TRUE
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass, levels = masses, labels = mass_labs),
    lw = if_else(f_ref == 0.75, 1.2, 0.6)
  ) %>%
  select(mass_lab, f_ref, lw, T, E_net_norm, f, g) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(E_net_norm, f, g), names_to = "var", values_to = "val")

p_temp <- ggplot(lines_T, aes(x = T, y = val, color = var, linetype = var, linewidth = lw, group = interaction(f_ref, var))) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(E_net_norm = "#67A5CA", f = "#238b45", g = "#6a51a3"), labels = c(E_net_norm = "Available energy", f = "f", g = "g")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(E_net_norm = "solid", f = "dashed", g = "dashed")) +
  scale_linewidth_identity() +
  facet_grid2(. ~ mass_lab, labeller = labeller(mass_lab = label_parsed)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30), limits = c(0, 30), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = axis_lab_T, y = expression("Allocation / " * C[max]), color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  th

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "temperature_limitation_two_sizes.png"), p_temp, width = 7, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)
p_temp

# Oxygen cross-sections at fixed T = 10 C
lines_O2 <- compute_state_surface(
  tr,
  masses = masses,
  Tseq = 10,
  pO2seq = seq(0, 30, by = 0.1),
  preys = c(0.5, 0.75),
  prey_units = "feeding_level",
  pair_mode = "cross",
  progress = TRUE
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass, levels = masses, labels = mass_labs),
    lw = if_else(f_ref == 0.75, 1.2, 0.6)
  ) %>%
  select(mass_lab, f_ref, lw, pO2, E_net_norm, f, g) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(E_net_norm, f, g), names_to = "var", values_to = "val")

p_o2 <- ggplot(lines_O2, aes(x = pO2, y = val, color = var, linetype = var, linewidth = lw, group = interaction(f_ref, var))) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(E_net_norm = "#67A5CA", f = "#238b45", g = "#6a51a3"), labels = c(E_net_norm = "Available energy", f = "f", g = "g")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(E_net_norm = "solid", f = "dashed", g = "dashed")) +
  scale_linewidth_identity() +
  facet_grid2(. ~ mass_lab, labeller = labeller(mass_lab = label_parsed)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30), limits = c(0, 30), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = axis_lab_O2, y = expression("Allocation / " * C[max]), color = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  th

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "oxygen_limitation_two_sizes.png"), p_o2, width = 7, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)
p_o2
```
